repair_map.owner: Test-only observation transport and evidence capture
repair_map.cause: converge() validates one set of reports then rereads files to persist a different set. The failing raw witness contains a={} while server and b have matching complete snapshots. The fixture truncates observation.json on each write; the second read can see incomplete JSON and return {}.
repair_map.fix: Persist the exact decoded sample that satisfied the predicate, without a second read. Publish fixture reports by writing and closing a sibling temporary file then renaming it onto the observation path. Treat rename failure as fixture failure, not PASS.
repair_map.not_symptom_patch: No tolerance, timeout, retry count or gameplay acceptance criterion is relaxed. Incomplete observations remain unacceptable. Runtime and network code are unchanged.
tests: valid sample is read once per participant and the same object is persisted
incomplete sample is rejected before a later complete sample can be stored
all R16 neutral acknowledgement falsifiers retained
